name: ULME token transfer access control
summary: The ULME token let an unauthorised caller move other holders' balances, so the attacker swept 101 holder addresses into the ULME/BUSD pair inside one flash-loan-funded transaction.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/ulme.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.

DeFiHackLabs carries two PoCs (ULME_exp and ULME_exp2) for this same incident; one row is recorded. lossUsd uses the ~$250k reported drained (the attacker's net profit after the frontrun was ~$50k); onchain, 200,170.83 USDT moved into the ULME/BUSD pair 0xf18e5EC98541D073dAA0864232B9398fa183e0d4 from holder addresses in this transaction.
